front_layout.note: AN OPEN UNIT HAS NO FRONT. 'none' is stated rather than left absent: Panel.effective_slabs defaults a missing layout to 'single' and would hang a door on an open box (same reason as open_tall_222.json).

open_end_unit_20.wall_hung_note: NOT OFFERED: no 'Surch. for wall-hung version' line in the margin of printed p.450-452 (110-dpi renders, 2026-10-03).
open_end_unit_20.plinth_from_run_note: Same as open_tall_222.json: an open end unit has no front to line up with a base run, so it is the plain article on its run's plinth (Project Guidelines p.87 / p.70).
open_end_unit_20.notes: Printed d.37,5 / 64,5 / 69,5 = side panel 35 / 62 / 67 + the 2,2 door plane (printed p.450 header: 'The depth measurements are based on 2.2 cm thick doors'). depth_includes_front: drawn from the door plane back, flush with the doored units beside it. WIDTH 20 IS CODED, NOT ORDERED: one width per row, unlike the 15-45 / 45-90 open units of printed p.455-456. price_points_by_band: the printed points, bands 1-11 of printed p.453-454. Bands 3, 9 and 11 are '-' on every row of p.450-452 and are ABSENT from the map, never 0 - '-' means not made in that finish. Nothing reads these yet (no appearance layer, M1.8); they are held because the row prints them and a re-read costs a render. The icon draws the open box with intermediate shelves; their number is read off an icon only and not recorded (interior_confirmed stays empty). IRREGULAR CODES COPIED AS PRINTED, never corrected (domain rule 5: codes decode only via explicit rows): F20250 (not C2-), C20251 / CF0251 / CR0251 / CH0251 / C90251 end in 51 where their d.37,5 sisters end in 50, and F90205 ends in 05. H.234 prints the same points as H.222 in bands 6-11, and F90205 prints 496 in both band 1 and band 2 - copied.
